anomalies.expected: EN/CHIP_PU should have a DC path to +3V3 (typically through a pull-up resistor), with a capacitor from EN to GND if an RC reset delay is intended.

evidence.quote: Microcontroller sheet, page 2/4: U1 pin 8 is labeled EN/CHIP_PU; C14 is labeled 1uF between +3V3 and the EN node, and C7 is labeled 10uF from that node to GND.

anomalies.impact: The EN pin lacks a defined DC pull-up, so the ESP32-C3 may fail to start or reset unpredictably; any internal weak bias may not provide the intended reliable reset behavior.

parsed.summary: The EN/CHIP_PU circuitry appears to AC-couple +3V3 through C14 rather than provide a DC pull-up, while C7 pulls the EN node toward GND. This can prevent reliable startup or reset of the controller.
